Écoute un extrait de trap fini : l'Intro: Listen to a clip of a finished trap beat: the Intro (the bell alone), then the Chorus, where the 808 (the very deep bass) lands with the kick. It's an instrumental: a rapper will put his voice on it. You're going to build it block by block.
À toi : règle le tempo (la vitesse du mo: Your turn: set the tempo (the song's speed) to 140 BPM, 140 beats per minute. “I'll do it” opens the Tempo sheet. It feels like 70: the snare or clap hit only lands once per bar.
Sans ça, ton morceau reste à 120 BPM : c: Otherwise your song stays at 120 BPM: that's not trap anymore.
À toi : choisis la couleur du morceau, s: Your turn: choose the song's colour, dark like trap. “I'll do it” opens the Key sheet: tap the two circled buttons, “Minor” (a dark scale), then “F” (the starting note).
À toi : règle la tonalité sur Fa mineur,: Your turn: set the key to F minor, “Minor” scale, “F” tonic. The 808 then plays on F2, 44 Hz: deep enough to shake, high enough for its distortion to be heard on a phone.
Sans cette gamme, ta 808 ne tombera pas: Without this scale, your 808 won't be in tune with the rest.
Le kick (la grosse caisse) tape peu en t: The kick (the bass drum) hits little in trap: three hits per bar, always with an 808 note. Together, they make one big hit.
Écoute le kick de la trap, seul : court,: Listen to the trap kick alone: short, it leaves the low end to the 808.
À toi : sur le pad « Kick studio », touc: Your turn: on the “Studio kick” pad, tap the dotted cells: the 1, then two bouncing hits.
Ton kick est court exprès, et accordé su: Your kick is short on purpose, and tuned to F like the 808: the 808 will play on its own track, with a note under each kick hit. A long kick would smear over it.
Kick court + 808 longue : le claquement: Short kick + long 808: the snap comes from the kick, the rumble from the 808.
Un seul clap par mesure, sur le 3e temps: A single clap per bar, on beat 3 (you count 1, 2, 3, 4): that's what makes trap slow and heavy.
À toi : sur le pad « Clap » (un claqueme: Your turn: on the “Clap” pad (a hand clap), tap the dotted cell: beat 3, the cell numbered 3.
À toi : sur le pad « Clap », le coup sur: Your turn: on the “Clap” pad, the hit on 3: the half-time.
Avec un seul clap par mesure, ton morcea: With a single clap per bar, your song at 140 dances at 70: that's trap's “half-time”.
Le charley (la petite cymbale qui fait «: The hi-hat (the little cymbal that goes “tss”) gives the speed. In trap, it rolls: very fast bursts, never twice in the same place.
À toi : les charleys tiennent sur 2 mesu: Your turn: the hi-hats span 2 bars (one bar = one round of the loop). Tap “Switch to 2 bars”, then on the “Hi-hat” pad, tap all the dotted cells. Tip: “Fill 1/2”, under the grid, places every other hit in one go.
À toi : « Passer à 2 mesures », puis sur: Your turn: “Switch to 2 bars”, then on the “Hi-hat” pad, the dotted cells (“Fill 1/2” places the eighths in one go). Bar 1, beat 4 in triplets: hold cell 13, “Triplet” › “3 over 2 cells”, then the same on cell 15. Bar 2, the rolls: cell 10, “Roll” ×3 (3 hits in the cell); cells 13 to 16, ×2 each, “↗ Rising” (the burst grows in strength up to the next 1).
Triolets dans une mesure, rafale dans l': Triplets in one bar, a burst in the other: never two identical bars, otherwise it sounds like a “preset”.
À toi : les triolets. Mesure 1, sur le p: Your turn: the triplets. Bar 1, on the “Hi-hat” pad, hold the hit on cell 13, then “Triplet” › “3 over 2 cells”; the same on cell 15. Three hits instead of two: the hi-hat “stumbles”, that's the flow of trap hi-hats.
Le triolet casse la régularité des doubl: The triplet breaks the regularity of the sixteenths: the ear is surprised just before the 1 comes back.
À toi : sur le pad « Charley ouvert » (u: Your turn: on the “Open hi-hat” pad (a longer “tsss”), tap the dotted cell of bar 2.
La 808, c'est la basse de la trap : une: The 808 is trap's bass: a very deep, long note under each kick, sometimes sliding to another note.
Écoute la 808 avec le kick : elle tombe: Listen to the 808 with the kick: it lands with it, holds for a long time, and twice slides up an octave (“woooh”).
À toi : touche « Créer la piste Basse »: Your turn: tap “Create the Bass track”: it's an 808 track. Tap the 3 dotted notes of bar 1: they land with the kick. Then the 4 notes of bar 2: the second-to-last lasts until under the last one, it slides. “Copy to the next bars” writes bars 3 and 4 (the same, lower, with the chords).
À toi : crée la piste Basse (une piste «: Your turn: create the Bass track (an “808 bass” track, written in the piano roll). Bar 1: F2 on the 3 kicks. Bar 2: the note on step 27 lasts until under F3 (step 31): two overlapping notes slide, up an octave. “Copy”: bars 3 and 4 go down to D♭ (VI) and E♭ (VII), octave slide included.
La 808 glisse quand une note dure jusqu': The 808 slides when a note lasts past the start of the next: few slides, or you stop noticing them.
Sans 808, ta trap n'a pas de grave : c'e: Without an 808, your trap has no low end: it's what makes the speakers shake.
À toi : au Mixeur, mets l'effet « Pompe: Your turn: in the Mixer, put the “Pump” effect on the 808 track: it ducks for a split second at each kick (sidechain). The kick snaps, the 808 rumbles right after.
Des cordes sombres tenues en fond : elle: Dark strings held in the background: they only play in the Chorus, to leave room for the voice during the verses.
À toi : touche « Créer la piste Accords: Your turn: tap “Create the Chords track”. Turn on “Chords”, in the row of buttons just above the grid (swipe it if you don't see it): tapping the bottom dotted note places all 3 notes of the chord. Do it in bar 1, then “Copy to the next bars”: the next chords go down by themselves.
À toi : crée la piste Accords (des corde: Your turn: create the Chords track (strings). Bar 1: F minor held one bar (“Chords” places the triad in one tap), then “Copy”: F minor, D♭ (VI) and E♭ (VII), following along the scale.
Sans accords, ton refrain n'aura pas sa: Without chords, your chorus won't have its dark colour.
La cloche joue une petite phrase de 2 me: The bell plays a little 2-bar phrase, from start to finish: it's what you remember. It doesn't move when the chord changes.
Listen to the bell melody with the 808.
À toi : touche « Créer la piste Mélodie: Your turn: tap “Create the Melody track”, then the dotted notes: 3 in bar 1, 4 in bar 2. There are gaps: that's on purpose. Then “Copy to the next bars”.
À toi : crée la piste Mélodie (« Cloche: Your turn: create the Melody track (“FM bell”) and write its 2 bars: F, C, A♭, then F, A♭, C, E♭, about one note per beat, with gaps. “Copy”: it stays the same over D♭ and E♭, where its notes become tensions (major 7th, 9th): the melancholic side.
Une phrase courte, répétée, avec du vide: A short, repeated phrase with space: the rapper remembers it and has room.
Sans mélodie, personne ne retiendra ton: Without a melody, no one will remember your beat.
Un morceau de rap, c'est une Intro, puis: A rap song is an Intro, then alternating Choruses and Verses. The Verse leaves room for the voice.
Écoute l'Intro : la cloche seule. C'est: Listen to the Intro: the bell alone. That's where the rapper gets ready (and where the producer slips in his signature, the “tag”).
Écoute le Couplet : sans les cordes, ave: Listen to the Verse: without the strings, with simpler hi-hats. The rapper's voice takes that place.
Moins de briques au Couplet : la voix pa: Fewer blocks in the Verse: the voice comes to the front.
Écoute le Refrain : tout revient, les co: Listen to the Chorus: everything comes back, the strings and the rolls.
Le Refrain revient trois fois : c'est le: The Chorus comes back three times: it's the moment everyone sings.
Bon à savoir : en trap, le rappeur compt: Good to know: in trap, the rapper counts one bar where the app counts two (he hears the clap on 2 and 4 of a slow bar). So his “16-bar” verse is 32 bars here, almost a minute.
Un couplet de 16 mesures de l'appli ne d: A 16-bar verse in the app would only last 27 seconds: too short for a real verse.
À toi : crée l'Intro à partir du Refrain: Your turn: create the Intro from the Chorus: only the melody stays.
La cloche seule donne envie sans tout mo: The bell alone builds desire without showing everything: when the kick and the 808 arrive, it all lands at once.
À toi : crée le Couplet à partir du Refr: Your turn: create the Verse from the Chorus: without the chords or the open hi-hat, with simpler hi-hats.
Le Couplet est la place de la voix : on: The Verse is the voice's place: we remove what would get in its way.
À toi : crée le Pré-refrain à partir du: Your turn: create the Pre-chorus from the Chorus: no kick or 808, for 2 bars just before each Chorus.
Quand la 808 se tait deux mesures, tout: When the 808 goes quiet for two bars, everyone waits for its return: the Chorus lands twice as hard.
À toi : dans « Le morceau », sous « Ajou: Your turn: in “The song”, under “Add”, tap in order the buttons ending in Intro, Chorus, Verse, Pre-chorus, Chorus, Verse, Pre-chorus, Chorus, then Intro for the Outro (the ending replays the Intro). The next step gives them their length.
Dans un autre ordre, la 808 ne se taira: In another order, the 808 won't go quiet right before each Chorus.
À toi : donne à chaque partie sa durée :: Your turn: give each part its length: Intro 4 bars, Chorus 16, Verse 30, Pre-chorus 2. Tap a part, then under “Length”, type the number of bars and “OK”. The “Set the suggested lengths” button does it all at once.
Couplet 30 + Pré-refrain 2 = 32 mesures,: Verse 30 + Pre-chorus 2 = 32 bars, the rapper's 16 bars. Chorus 16 = his 8. 3 min 26 in all.
À toi : dans la partie « Pré-refrain »,: Your turn: in the “Pre-chorus” part, “Bar 2”, “Hi-hat” pad: hold the last hit before the end, then “Roll” ×4 “↗ Rising”: a burst rising up to the Chorus.
À toi : dans la partie « Refrain », pose: Your turn: in the “Chorus” part, place a hit on the “Crash” pad (the big cymbal) in the very first cell: the Chorus arrives with a splash.
La réverbe (l'écho d'une grande salle) d: The reverb (the echo of a big hall) gives the clap and the strings space; the echo repeats the bell in rhythm.
Écoute la réverbe : la batterie et les a: Listen to the reverb: the drums and the chords, first without, then with. The sound takes up space.
À toi : au Mixeur, touche le nom de la p: Your turn: in the Mixer, tap the “Chords” track's name, then in “Reverb and echo”, raise “Reverb send”. Do the same on the “Clap” pad's channel.
À toi : au Mixeur, sur la piste « Mélodi: Your turn: in the Mixer, on the “Melody” track, raise “Echo send”: each bell note repeats, like in Metro Boomin's beats.
À toi : au Mixeur, baisse un peu les fad: Your turn: in the Mixer, lower the “Chords” and “Melody” faders a little: the kick and the 808 in front, the strings far behind.
Le master colle le tout et donne au morc: The master glues it all and gives the song the loudness of trap songs, without crushing the kick.
À toi : dans « Sortie générale », règle: Your turn: in “Master output”, set “Target loudness” to “Auto (style)”: it aims for trap songs' loudness (about -8.5 LUFS). The built-in limiter, always last, stops the sound from going over.
